pages.title: Put
pages.text: A dispenser item denotes the "put" action, which is filtered the same way as the "take" action.$(br2)If possible, the mob will place a held item as a block rather than dropping it on the ground.
If you tell a bound spider to put a cobweb somewhere, it need not be holding any cobwebs - it will spin one at the desired location, at the cost of a little of its health.
